entities.name: Light-Paws
entities.description: Kitsune advisor at the Imperial Palace in Eiganjo Castle and acting Regent of Kamigawa.

entities.name: Eiko
entities.description: Young ward of Light-Paws trained as a Kami Intercessor.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: Ward of Light-Paws whose relation with her became strained.

entities.name: The Emperor
entities.description: Planeswalking Emperor of Kamigawa who appointed Light-Paws regent and lost her spark in the Desparkening.

events.summary: Light-Paws calms a furious lost kami unarmed, earning her second tail.
events.quote: managed to calm the kami and prevent further harm

events.summary: The emperor appoints Light-Paws his personal advisor and teacher of the palace's young.
events.quote: he appointed Light-Paws as his personal advisor

events.summary: After the Emperor vanishes, Kaito leaves Eiganjo.
The returning Emperor appoints Light-Paws acting Regent of Kamigawa.
events.quote: appointed Light-Paws as acting Regent of Kamigawa

events.summary: The Emperor loses her spark in the Desparkening and Light-Paws continues as regent.
events.quote: the Emperor lost her spark in the Desparkening

relations.note: trained her as a Kami Intercessor
relations.quote: Light-Paws was the mentor of young Eiko and Kaito Shizuki
